position.label: PT-sUSDe collateral on Morpho Blue, USDC borrowed (position A)

method: Real price paths replayed through the same engine as the stress scenarios. On-chain path: every round of the Chainlink USDe/USD feed, read at the frozen block. Off-chain price (exchange order book): curated, with its source and date.

replays.title: 10 October 2025: USDe at $0.65 on Binance
replays.story: Crash of 10 October 2025: on the Binance order book, USDe falls to $0.65 for about forty minutes, while on-chain it stays close to $1. Binance valued this collateral with ITS own price: positions were liquidated there. What would position A have lived through?

offchain.says: USDe "briefly plunging to $0.65" on Binance spot, recovered "within about 40 minutes"; closer to $1 on decentralised venues (Curve).

designs.why: max deviation 0.71% vs threshold 0.75%; above the threshold for 0.0 min (960 min needed to switch) → no switch, fixed price

designs.design: Market oracle on the Binance (spot order book) price
designs.why: Binance (spot order book) at $0.65 for ~40 min (curated source); on-chain the PT was still worth ~1: the liquidator buys the collateral back at a discount

replays.takeaway: Same real crisis, opposite outcomes: 2 oracle design(s) hold, but Market oracle on the Binance (spot order book) price: liquidated, $53,133 lost. The source of the oracle decides who gets liquidated.

replays.title: 21 February 2025: the worst deviation ever seen by the Chainlink USDe/USD feed
replays.story: The day the Chainlink USDe/USD feed recorded its all-time low ($0.977), for a few minutes. Replayed on position A: would the oracle have switched? would we have been liquidated?

designs.why: max deviation 2.31% vs threshold 0.75%; above the threshold for 38.4 min (960 min needed to switch) → no switch, fixed price

replays.takeaway: No oracle design is liquidated: the real shock stayed below what the position can absorb (lowest health factor 1.026, liquidation below 1).
